description:
- New WhatsApp reminder, the twin of the SMS one: switch it on in a task's special features, pick the number (contacts or typed), and Ping sends the task's notes (or its title) to that number over WhatsApp every time a reminder fires. It is available when creating and editing a task and is carried by cloud sync, desktop sync and backups.
- Settings > Special task settings has a new "WhatsApp reminders" panel: link Ping to your WhatsApp account once (enter your number, then type the 8-character code Ping shows into WhatsApp > Linked devices > Link a device > Link with phone number instead), send yourself a test message, or unlink. It shares the default country code with the SMS panel.
- WhatsApp does not officially allow third-party apps; a few messages to people you already talk to is low risk. Failed sends are skipped silently, like SMS. The WhatsApp login is excluded from Android backups.
- The APK now includes the WhatsApp library for 64-bit ARM phones (about 16 MB larger).
